newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil bolsa ready to begin CVRD sale.
newsitem.headline: Brazil bolsa ready to begin CVRD sale.

text.p: The Rio de Janeiro stock exchange is ready to begin the auction of Brazilian mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD)as soon as it gets the green light, the bolsa's head said.
Fernando Opitz told reporters the exchange was just waiting for National Development Bank (BNDES) officials to say court injunctions preventing the auction had been overturned.
"Everything is ready for 1000 (1300 GMT). As soon as we have the green light from the BNDES that the injunctions have been revoked we can start," Opitz said.
Forty-five percent of CVRD's voting shares were due to go under the hammer at 1000 local with a $2.8 billion base price but the BNDES still has four outstanding injunctions to quash.
The BNDES has given its team of lawyers until 5.00 p.m. local/2000 GMT to overturn the law suits.

The Rio bolsa was ringed off Tuesday by high fences and some 650 police dressed in riot gear. Opponents of what would be Latin America's largest privatization to date have pledged to bring in 5,000 demonstrators.
